en.headline: Seven new members appointed to Transport Advisory Committee
en.dek: The Chief Executive reappointed two serving members and named seven new ones with effect from 1 October, two of them through the youth self-recommendation scheme.
body: The Government announced today that the Chief Executive has reappointed two incumbent members of the Transport Advisory Committee and appointed seven new members, with the changes taking effect on 1 October.

The serving members to be reappointed are Dr Isaac Ng Ka-chui and Ms Cally Chan Shan-shan. The new members are Dr Blanc Wan Chun-pong, Mr Anthony Kong Shing-hei, Miss He Xiulei, Professor Franklin Yu, Mr Jason Chong Chin-ming, Miss Peggy Tse Pui-kei and Miss Rosalind Lee. Mr Kong and Miss He were appointed through the Member Self-recommendation Scheme for Youth.

The Secretary for Transport and Logistics, Ms Mable Chan, said the Government valued the committee’s advice on significant transport issues and looked forward to working closely with members. She also thanked seven outgoing members, including Mr Ricky Yu Wai-yip, Mr Hugh Chow Hin-poon, Professor Joel Chan Cho-sing, Ms Iris Wan Lai-sze, Dr Cheng Shing-fung, Ms Dilys Chau Suet-fung and Miss Chan Hong-yee, for their contributions.
The committee is a key advisory body on transport policy and major transport-related proposals. It currently comprises 16 non-official members, including the chairman, plus three ex-officio members.

zh.headline: 交諮會七名新成員獲委任 十月一日生效
zh.dek: 行政長官再委任兩名現任委員，並新委任七人，當中兩人經青年委員自薦計劃出任，任期由十月一日起。
body: 政府今日宣布，行政長官再委任交通諮詢委員會兩名現任委員，並新委任七名委員，有關任命由十月一日起生效。
獲再委任的現任委員為吳家超博士及陳珊珊。新任委員為尹振邦博士、江承禧、何秀蕾、余遠騰教授、莊展明、謝瑋琦及李樂怡。江承禧及何秀蕾經青年委員自薦計劃獲委任。
運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，政府重視交諮會多年來就重要運輸議題提供的意見，期望繼續與委員緊密合作。她同時感謝即將卸任的余偉業、周顯邦、陳祖聲教授、溫麗施、鄭成豐博士、周雪鳳及陳康儀所作貢獻。
交諮會是政府就運輸政策及重大運輸建議的主要諮詢組織，現時包括主席在內共有16名非官方委員，另有三名當然委員。
